any finite type quasi-coherent <MATH_0011>-module

As a base change of the affine morphism <MATH_0015>
the morphism <MATH_0016> is affine. Thus <MATH_0017> is
quasi-coherent. Write

as a filtered colimit of its finite type quasi-coherent

Since <MATH_0020> is a sheaf of <MATH_0021>-vector spaces over <MATH_0022>,
it is flat over <MATH_0023>. Thus each <MATH_0024> is flat

and torsion freeness is inherited by submodules.
